title: Predicted UFO hovers over Puharich family gathering
summary: Greg tells of Predicted UFO hovers over Puharich family gathering, about late 1980s at North Carolina, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher named Greg, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on an account from the family of Andy Puharich, a scientist the episode links to contact with an alien council. Greg says that at a family gathering in North Carolina in the late 1980s, a UFO had been predicted in advance, and Puharich's son and two or three cousins all saw a huge thing hover silently over them. He mentions a family video connected to the event, and if true, it would mean the sighting was foretold.
